feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 10:56pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 22 October 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Rain will arrive around or shortly after midnight, becoming persistent and quite heavy as winds increase.

Heavy rain will continue at first tomorrow, with a risk of localised flooding, turning lighter around lunchtime before gradually clearing later in the afternoon. Strong northwest winds, touching gale force in exposed spots for a time, the maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

A very unsettled weekend, with heavy rain developing on Saturday morning with gale force southerly winds. The wind will turn westerly later in the day as the rain clears, then later in the evening and overnight into Sunday severe gales are likely, with gusts up to 70 mph.

Travel disruption and some damage is likely, before winds gradually ease later on Sunday.
